name: Select / combobox
looksLike: field with a down arrow that opens choices
box where I pick one item from a list
type in a field to narrow the available choices
definition: A field for choosing an option. A select offers fixed choices; an editable combobox also lets users type to find options and may allow a custom value.
whenToUse: Searching a long list of options

notConfusedWith.difference: Runs commands such as Rename; a select or combobox sets a field value.

prompts.short: Add a labeled select with keyboard-operable options and a visible selected value.
prompts.detailed: Add a native select for a fixed list of choices, with an associated label, visible focus, and a 44px target. For a searchable combobox, use an accessible implementation with a labeled input, expanded state, linked listbox, arrow-key navigation, Enter selection, and Escape dismissal.

html: <!-- Fixed-choice select. An editable combobox needs additional keyboard and focus behavior. -->
vue: a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }

a11yNotes: Associate a visible label and retain keyboard operation
Use native select for simple fixed choices
For custom comboboxes, expose expanded state and active option; support Escape and Enter
